summary: Backend verification of /api/articles/aliases/map (real alias resolution) and alias-aware /api/articles/{slug}/ai-tldr. Tested via external preview URL. 8/8 pytest tests PASSED. aliases/map now returns alias_count=56, canonical_count=38, count=56 (backward-compat mirror). Specific aliases verified: xian-incident -> xian-incident-republican-china-politics; HBS_Case_Study_FINAL -> hbs-case-study-final; Tourism_Case_Hospitality_2025 -> tourism-case-hospitality-2025. ai-tldr transparent resolution works for legacy slug (xian-incident), Title_Case underscore stem (HBS_Case_Study_FINAL), lowercase underscore stem (hbs_case_study_final); direct canonical (core-code-theory) still works with resolved_via_alias=false; nonexistent slug still returns 404. Stub complaint fully resolved.

minor.issue: Response field is named 'canonical' (full URL) — spec/review-request called it 'canonical_url'. Consumers depending on either name should be documented; consider adding a canonical_url alias field for clarity.

critical_code_review_comments: Field naming inconsistency: ai-tldr returns 'canonical' while review spec references 'canonical_url'. Either rename or add alias key.
server.py continues to grow (~490+ line endpoints); consider extracting alias helpers (_slugify, _compute_aliases, _LEGACY_SLUG_RENAMES) into a dedicated module for testability.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Alias resolution feature verified end-to-end against https://insightbridge-web.preview.emergentagent.com. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_article_aliases.py can be re-run as a regression check. 56 aliases / 38 canonicals is the current expected shape; update test_counts if canonical set grows.
rca of the issue: Prior bug: /api/articles/aliases/map returned empty aliases dict (stub). Fix implemented by main agent: _compute_aliases() registers every publication filename stem (Title_Case + lowercase) plus hand-curated _LEGACY_SLUG_RENAMES entries; ai-tldr endpoint resolves via alias map before returning 404. Verified working.
